items.title: 21.7 Cosmic redshift: phailti kainat ka saboot (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of cosmic redshift (PDF 175-176).

blocks.text: Cosmic redshift woh asar hai jis mein door ki kehkashaon ki roshni spectrum ke surkh sire ki taraf khinch jati hai. Yeh is liye hota hai ke kainat phail rahi hai, is liye kehkashanein ham se door ja rahi hain aur un ki kharij roshni ki wavelength barhti hai. Kehkashan jitni door, us ka redshift utna zyada, yani woh utni tezi se door ja rahi hai. Cosmic redshift parh kar scientists naap sakte hain ke kainat kitni tezi se phail rahi hai.

Wavelength ki naapi gayi tabdeeli source aur dekhne wale ke darmiyan nisbati velocity v se juri hai: z = dlambda/lambda = df/f = v/c (21.4), jo taqreeban tab durust hai jab v, c se bohat kam ho. Musbat dlambda redshift batata hai, yani cheez zameen se door ja rahi hai; manfi dlambda blueshift hai, yani qareeb aa rahi hai. Door ki kehkashaon ki roshni tawaqqo se zyada surkh lagti hai kyunke kainat phailne ke saath khud khala khinch rahi hai, jo roshni ki lehron ko bhi khainchti hai. Redshift ka naqsha har simt nazar aata hai, jo dikhata hai ke kainat phail rahi hai: sirf kehkashanein khala mein door nahi ja rahin, balke un ke darmiyan khala barh rahi hai. Yeh nataij Big Bang theory ki mazboot taeed karte hain, jis ke mutabiq kainat bohat garam aur ghani halat se shuru hui aur tab se barh rahi hai.

blocks.title: Equation 21.4
blocks.text: Kitab equation 21.4 ko 'Z = dl/l >> df/f >> v/c' chhapti hai. Yeh miqdarein taqreeban barabar hain, aik doosre se bohat bari nahi: z = dlambda/lambda = df/f = v/c (frequency ki tabdeeli ka nishan ulat hai), jo roshni ki raftar se bohat kam raftaron par durust hai.

Laboratory mein 656.3 nm wavelength wali hydrogen lakeer aik kehkashan ke spectrum mein 662.9 nm par nazar aati hai. Kehkashan ki door jane ki velocity maloom karein. Hal: z = dlambda/lambda = (662.9 - 656.3)/656.3 = 0.0101, is liye v = zc = 0.0101 x 3.0 x 10^8 m s^-1 = 3.0 x 10^6 m s^-1, door jati hui.

blocks.prompt: Sitare ki spectral lakeer laboratory se chhoti wavelength par nazar aati hai. Yeh kya batata hai?
blocks.explanation: Yeh blueshift hai: sitara hamari taraf aa raha hai.

items: Redshift: z = dlambda/lambda = v/c (v, c se bohat kam); musbat: door ja rahi.
Har simt redshift: khala phail rahi; Big Bang ki taeed.
